 import math
 
 # OMEGA-BLOCK-START
+REPULSION_DIST = 0.22
+REPULSION_STEPS = 20

+def optimize_centers(centers):
+    """Push centers apart to reduce overlap and increase potential radii."""
+    for _ in range(REPULSION_STEPS):
+        for i in range(len(centers)):
+            for j in range(i + 1, len(centers)):
+                dx = centers[j][0] - centers[i][0]
+                dy = centers[j][1] - centers[i][1]
+                dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
+                if dist < REPULSION_DIST and dist > 0:
+                    move = (REPULSION_DIST - dist) / 2.0
+                    nx, ny = dx / dist, dy / dist
+                    centers[i] = (centers[i][0] - nx * move, centers[i][1] - ny * move)
+                    centers[j] = (centers[j][0] + nx * move, centers[j][1] + ny * move)
+            margin = REPULSION_DIST / 2.0
+            for i, c in enumerate(centers):
+                x, y = c
+                if x < margin: x = margin
+                if x > 1 - margin: x = 1 - margin
+                if y < margin: y = margin
+                if y > 1 - margin: y = 1 - margin
+                centers[i] = (x, y)
